summary: READ-ONLY QA audit of GlobalCalc (Next.js 16 App Router) completed. All 6 calculators verified mathematically correct against the spec. All 29 routes return expected status codes (28x 200, 1x 404). Header/hero/in-page search + filter chips work. Mobile hamburger works. SEO meta (title, description, canonical, OG, Twitter) and JSON-LD (WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) all present on calculator pages. No console errors other than the pre-known @vercel/analytics 404 in dev/preview. Only minor content/UX gaps found; no functional bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Currency values render without a currency symbol. Spec calls for '$60' / '$20' / '$386.66' but UI shows bare '60.00' / '20.00' / '386.66' in ResultCallout, ResultList, and the '(25%)' sublabel. Values are numerically correct; only the '$' prefix is missing. money() uses toLocaleString with only fraction-digits options, no {style:'currency', currency:'USD'}.
Sublabel builds `(${d}%)` from the raw parsed number so decimal input like 25.5 shows as '25.5%' with no formatting; not a bug but slightly inconsistent with other formatted numbers on the same page.

issues: Console error on every navigation: 'Failed to load resource: /_vercel/insights/script.js 404'. This is the pre-known @vercel/analytics issue in non-production env and is expected — no fix needed.

Age.2000-02-29 -> 2024-02-28 (leap edge): 23y 11m 30d — mathematically correct (birthday hasn't recurred yet on 2024-02-28)

verified_math_and_flows.Routing: All 28 expected paths return 200; /nonexistent-page returns 404. Both /calculators/[category-slug] AND /categories/[category-slug] work (duplicate category listings intentional per lib/calculators.ts categoryPath).
verified_math_and_flows.Navigation: Header (Home/Calculators/Categories) & mobile hamburger open/close verified. Breadcrumbs render on calculator + category pages. 'Related calculators' section present on Age & Date pages (both in date-time category) and correctly ABSENT on Percentage/BMI/Discount/Loan — matches known content gap.
verified_math_and_flows.Search: Hero search redirects to /calculators?q=<term>; in-page search input (class .h-12) filters live: 'percent'->Percentage only, 'bmi'->BMI only, 'xyzxyz'->'No calculators found' empty state, clearing restores all 6. Filter chip group has role='group' aria-label='Filter by category'.
verified_math_and_flows.SEO: Title, meta description, canonical, OG (type/siteName/title/description/url/locale), Twitter card=summary_large_image all present. JSON-LD @type WebApplication + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage all emitted on calculator pages; breadcrumb items and FAQ Q&A match visible page content.
verified_math_and_flows.Responsive: Desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 checked on homepage, /calculators, and all 6 calculator pages. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth on mobile). Two-column Inputs/Result grid collapses to single column on mobile.
verified_math_and_flows.Accessibility: All calc inputs have <label htmlFor>. Segmented toggles have role='group' and aria-pressed on each button. Error messages use role='alert' via ErrorNote. Heading hierarchy h1 (page title) -> h2 (sections) preserved. Focus ring visible via focus-visible:ring on inputs & buttons.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Consider updating money() in components/calculator/impl/fields.tsx to include a currency symbol (e.g. {style:'currency', currency:'USD'}) so Discount and Loan results match the '$60' / '$386.66' style described in the spec/example content. Currently outputs plain '60.00'.
OPTIONAL/LOW: In DiscountCalculator ResultCallout sublabel, format the discount percentage via fmt() for consistency with other numbers.
NO ACTION: Confirmed the @vercel/analytics /_vercel/insights/script.js 404 in dev/preview — expected, not to fix per audit request.
critical_code_review_comments: money() helper omits currency symbol despite being used exclusively for monetary values (final price, savings, monthly payment, total interest, total payment). Cheap fix, larger UX win.

Two separate category route trees exist (/calculators/[category] and /categories/[slug]) — both return 200 with similar content. This may cause duplicate-content SEO concerns; canonical URLs should point at one canonical category path. lib/calculators.ts categoryPath() returns /calculators/{slug}, but /categories/{slug} is also live.

Age calc note: for a leap-day DOB (2000-02-29) evaluated on 2024-02-28, result is 23y 11m 30d. Mathematically correct, but some products treat 'has your birthday occurred this year?' for Feb-29 births as 'Yes on Feb 28 in non-leap years and on Feb 29 in leap years'. Consider documenting this convention in the FAQ.
Discount sublabel interpolates raw `${d}` without number formatting — inconsistent with fmt()/money() usage elsewhere.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of core flows pass; 2 low-severity display gaps

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a client-only Next.js 16 app at /app root (no backend/DB). All 6 calculators verified. Only minor cosmetic gaps found. If main agent adds a $ prefix to money(), re-run the loan and discount playwright checks above and re-check no test-id regressions on [data-testid=calc-result]. All calculator components use data-testid='calc-error'/'calc-empty'/'calc-result' and segment-<value> for mode buttons; input ids follow #pct-a/#pct-b, #age-dob/#age-asof, #bmi-kg/#bmi-cm/#bmi-lb/#bmi-ft/#bmi-in, #disc-price/#disc-percent, #loan-amount/#loan-rate/#loan-years, #date-start/#date-end/#date-base/#date-days.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical issues to RCA. The single confirmed console 404 (_vercel/insights/script.js) is the @vercel/analytics client attempting to hit its bundle path; in a Vercel prod deployment it is served automatically, but in a self-hosted 'next dev'/preview env there is no such route, hence the 404. It is guarded to only render in NODE_ENV=production per app/layout.tsx, but the request still occurs in preview builds where NODE_ENV=production but the /_vercel edge is absent — expected per the audit brief.
